requirements.rule: Retribuzione individuale di anzianità frozen at 1993-12-31 per Art. 56 (no new seniority accruals). Modelled as seniority_increments.maximum_count=0.
requirements.remediation: Let the caller state the RIA frozen at 1993-12-31 (EarnedIncrements or an individual allowance) and record the limitation.

requirements.rule: PART-TIME SUPPLEMENTARY HOURS: the ore supplementari of a part-time worker are paid with 15% of the retribuzione oraria globale (Art. 22, CCNL 8 October 2020, p. 25). OvertimeKind.SUPPLEMENTARY exists, but the file has no supplementary-hours band: the event takes the overtime bands unless the caller passes the multiplier (review of 2026-10-30).
requirements.remediation: Add the supplementary-hours band (15%) of Art. 22.

requirements.rule: The run reads an INPS ruleset marked provisional: the INPS circulars of its year are not published yet, so the rates, the massimale and the minimale (and the hourly contributions of domestic work) are those of the year before, carried over. The indexed amounts change every January: the carried-over values understate them.
requirements.remediation: Replace each provisional INPS ruleset of the year with the values of the INPS circulars of the year, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: The run reads a tax ruleset marked provisional: the sources of its year are not published yet (budget law of the year; regional and municipal surtax resolutions), so the values are those of the year before, carried over. Rules in force by statute (the IRPEF brackets of art. 11 and the deductions of art. 13 of the testo unico of D.Lgs. 117/2026) carry over unchanged; any change of the budget law is not applied.
requirements.remediation: Replace each provisional ruleset of the year with the values of its published sources, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: SHIFT, ON-CALL AND RISK ALLOWANCES (Art. 60-61, pp. 89-90): the indennità notturna of 2,74 euro an hour of shift between 22 and 6, the holiday shift indemnity of 17,82 euro (8,91 for half a shift or less), the pronta disponibilità of 21,69 euro per 12 hours and the radiation risk indemnity of 1.239,50 euro a year are not modelled: no field of the request states the shifts or the on-call duty of the worker.
requirements.remediation: Model the Art. 60-61 indemnities with facts naming the night and holiday shift hours and the on-call turns of the worker.

requirements.rule: The CCNL tier and the comporto are counted on the days of one episode and the relapses it continues. A CCNL that sums the sickness of separate episodes over a window (a calendar year, the last three years) can reach a lower tier or the end of the comporto earlier than the engine shows. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.day.rules (CCNL tier of a sick day)
requirements.remediation: Add the cumulation window of each CCNL to its sickness rule, with the source, and count the tier and the comporto over it.

requirements.rule: The INPS share of a sick day is the INPS rate times the CCNL daily quota of the current month, counted on the CCNL payable days, when the episode does not let the engine compute the INPS daily base: no SicknessEpisode.inps_base in its relapse chain, an operaio without the days worked or paid of the month before, an impiegato of a month not worked in full without the pay of a whole month, an unknown worker category, or a sector INPS regime (spettacolo). With the base, INPS pays its share on the retribuzione media globale giornaliera of the month before the illness and on calendar days (INPS circ. 134368/1981 point 11). The worker's total for the day is the same; the split between INPS indemnity (outside the contribution base) and employer integration may differ, and with it the contributions.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.pay.handlers (INPS share of a sick day); ccnl_engine.sickness.base.rules (daily base)
requirements.remediation: Compute the base of the sector regimes, and from the closing state of the engine's own runs so the caller need not state it, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: CCNL applied in ultrattività; Decreto Lavoro 2026 introduced a statutory 30% IPCA auto-adjustment if no renewal within 12 months of expiry. If triggered, legally applicable 2026 minimums may exceed the 2020 Tabella 1 values modelled here. Engine models contractual tables only.
requirements.remediation: Verify whether the statutory IPCA adjustment applies to T011 under ultrattività and model it, or record the limitation.

requirements.rule: An apprentice whose TFR goes to a pension fund or to the Fondo Tesoreria takes the 0.28-point relief of D.L. 203/2005 art. 8, but not the exemption from the 0.20% Fondo di garanzia contribution of D.Lgs. 252/2005 art. 10 c. 2: no source found says whether the apprentice rate (10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus NASpI and the integration funds) holds a Fondo di garanzia share to exempt. The employer contributions of the run may be overstated by 0.20% of the INPS base.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.severance.relief.services; INPS messaggio n. 5859 of 7 March 2008, par. 3 (art. 8 relief of apprentices); INPS circ. 70/2007 par. 6 (Fondo di garanzia exemption, rates 0.20% and 0.40%)
requirements.remediation: Find an INPS source on the Fondo di garanzia share of the apprentice rate, then exempt it with the other workers or record that none is due.
